worldcombat.skill.assurance.summary: Chase down a target that has already been hurt recently: this strike's power is doubled while its wound is still fresh. Higher Attack and Speed chase harder.
worldcombat.skill.assurance.use.0: Finish a target an ally has already softened
worldcombat.skill.assurance.use.1: Land a hit in the window right after the foe is damaged
worldcombat.skill.assurance.use.2: Run a low-health target off the field
The pursuit deals about %1$s physical damage; if the target has taken damage within the last %2$s seconds, the power is doubled.
Chase up to %1$s blocks, %2$s blocks per tick, with a %3$s block hit radius; a hit knocks the target back about %4$s blocks and trails about %5$s dark quills.
worldcombat.skill.assurance.relentless.o: Relentless on: the pursuit window is 0.6s longer and the chase reaches about 8% farther, staying on a wounded target; in exchange the hit is about ×0.90 and the cooldown is 5 ticks longer.
Relentless off: the hit is about ×1.06 and finishes cleanly, reading only fresh wounds.
worldcombat.skill.assurance.timing: Cast on an enemy within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds it spends %4$s PP to fire, then recovers for %3$s seconds and starts a %5$s second cooldown on commit.
worldcombat.skill.assurance.growth.0: At level %1$s the pursuit power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.assurance.growth.1: At level %1$s the pursuit power rises to %2$s and the chase reaches %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.assurance.preference.r: On: the pursuit window is 0.6s longer and the chase reaches ×1.08 farther, staying on a wounded target; but the hit is ×0.90 and the cooldown is 5 ticks longer. Off: the hit is ×1.06 and the chase finishes cleanly.
worldcombat.skill.assurance.preference.a: Chase a target only within this distance; raise it to pursue wounded targets farther away.
On: a target hurt recently or already below 60% health is prioritised (exactly the doubled window); off: it sorts as an ordinary melee attack.
